schedule_timetables.description: Schedule management. list reads native timetable metadata; includeTimetables explicitly expands all rows. set_block changes one native block with dryRun and explicit confirm/task. Other actions retain their existing contracts.
schedule_timetables.action: list, create, set_block, assign_dupe or optimize.
schedule_timetables.schedule: Exact schedule name for list or set_block. Names must resolve uniquely; assign_dupe retains its existing name lookup.
schedule_timetables.hour: set_block local hour 0–23 in timetableIndex; row 0 remains the default.
schedule_timetables.group: set_block native group ID from list (for example Hygene, Worktime, Recreation or Sleep).
schedule_timetables.timetable_index: Zero-based timetable row for list or set_block. Default 0 preserves the first row; this never changes the native current timetable.
schedule_timetables.include_timetables: list only: explicitly include every timetable and block. Default false returns only the selected row.
schedule_timetables.dry_run: set_block true previews the exact row/hour/group without native writes or notifications. Other actions follow their own preview contracts.
schedule_timetables.confirm: set_block requires true when dryRun=false. Other actions retain existing confirmation rules.
schedule_timetables.list_description: Read existing schedule metadata. blocks remains the first 24 by default; select timetableIndex or explicitly include all timetables.
schedule_timetables.set_description: Set one existing native schedule block. Preview with dryRun=true; execution requires confirm=true and task. timetableIndex defaults to 0.
schedule_timetables.preview: Preview only; no native schedule changes or notifications were invoked.
schedule_timetables.no_change: The selected block already has the requested group; no native change was needed.
schedule_timetables.applied: Observed the requested block group after one native Schedule.SetBlockGroup call.
